title: Migrate smallhold to fieldwork::db schema
description:
Replace smallhold's inline schema (db.rs) with fieldwork::db::migrate(). Major refactor:
- Add fieldwork dependency with db-sqlite feature
- Replace SqlitePool with fieldwork::db::Pool
- Split 'accounts' table into users+personas:
  - Create a single user row per smallhold instance
  - Map each account to a persona under that user
  - Update all queries: account_id -> persona_id, add user_id where needed
- Update timestamp handling: already INTEGER but verify units are seconds not ms
- Replace run_migrations() with fieldwork::db::migrate()
- Remove inline schema constants and ALTER TABLE migrations
- Update all 39 tables worth of queries to match canonical column names
- Run full test suite
